verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions ring groups, sequential or simultaneous dialing, or no-answer forwarding to another number. The only related items are generic voice primitives: answering calls and recording them without a person (twilio-docs-23), and a user's self-built voicemail-to-webhook setup (twilio-comm-15). These are developer building blocks and user workarounds, so they earn no credit toward a ring-group routing capability.
